items.item: A stepper names each step and lets the user go back to earlier steps
items.evidence: renderStepper(): <ol id="stepper"> with STEPS = Upload file / Map columns / Preview / Import; steps with i <= S.maxStep render as <button data-step> wired to goStep(), current step gets aria-current="step". Also a Back button on the preview step. Back-navigation is disabled only while the import is running.

items.item: Column mapping auto-matches headers and marks required target fields
items.evidence: loadText() auto-maps each header via FIELDS[].aliases and norm(h) (e.g. 'Product code' -> SKU). mapHtml() marks required options with ' *', shows a 'Required fields' panel with Mapped/Missing badges, and S.mapError blocks Continue with 'Map the required fields before continuing: ...'.

items.item: The preview table shows per-row errors and an error count, and offers to download the failing rows
items.evidence: previewHtml(): per-row 'Result' badge and 'Issue' column (first error plus '(+N more)'), 'With errors' filter tab with count, banner '<n> rows · <n> with errors', and button data-act="dl-errors" 'Download failed rows' (failedCsv() adds an Error column).

items.item: The import shows progress, can continue in the background, and ends with a summary of created, updated and failed rows
items.evidence: importHtml(): role="progressbar" with 'Importing x of y rows' and live created/updated/failed counts. 'Run in background' button (data-a="bg") plus a Jobs button in the top bar and a toast on completion. The final screen has Created/Updated/Failed/Skipped figures, a failed-rows table and 'Download failed rows'.

items.item: The flow runs on a page or a full-width panel, not inside a small modal
items.evidence: The flow renders in <main> inside a max-w-6xl container with a breadcrumb, h1 'Import products' and a sticky action bar. The only modal (#dlg, max-w-md) is used for discard/stop confirmations.

items.item: A template file is offered for download before upload
items.evidence: On the upload step: header link #tplLink 'Download CSV template' and a second link data-act="template" in 'Before you start'. Both call downloadTemplate(), which produces products-import-template.csv with headers and an example row. The screenshot confirms both links are visible.

notes: Clean, restrained admin page. Plain white sidebar with a light-blue active item, a single blue accent, 4-6px radii, no gradient, glass, emoji, KPI icon tiles or promo card, and no uppercase tracked labels. Status badges are semantic (green/amber/red/blue/slate), not rainbow. The final-step figures (Created/Updated/Failed/Skipped) are plain bordered cards with no icons and no deltas. The audit score is 100 with no violations. Minor notes: 'Go to products' opens a stub dialog, since the demo has no product list; and the stepper blocks going back while an import is running. Only the upload step is shown in the screenshot, so the other steps were judged from the markup and script.
